papers.title_zh: 整模型内核、编译器与持久化运行时
papers.note_en: Core work that turns a model or tensor program into one persistent execution substrate.
papers.note_zh: 将模型或张量程序转化为单一持久化执行底座的核心工作。

papers.note_en: Layer- and subgraph-scale megakernels that jointly schedule expert computation, routing, and communication.
papers.note_zh: 在层或子图尺度联合调度专家计算、路由与通信的 Megakernel。

papers.note_en: Persistent threads, task abstractions, synchronization, and software pipelines that modern systems build upon.
papers.note_zh: 现代系统所依赖的持久线程、任务抽象、同步机制与软件流水线。

papers.note_en: Useful counterpoints and smaller-scope fusion work; these are not presented as whole-model LLM megakernels.
papers.note_zh: 有价值的对照方案与较小范围融合工作；不将它们表述为整模型 LLM Megakernel。

repos.title_zh: 整模型编译器、运行时与制品
repos.note_en: Systems that compile or execute a full model inside a persistent kernel or equivalent engine.
repos.note_zh: 在持久化内核或等价引擎中编译、执行完整模型的系统。

repos.note_en: Concrete implementations optimized around a model family, accelerator, or deployment shape.
repos.note_zh: 围绕特定模型族、加速器或部署形态优化的具体实现。

repos.title_zh: 分布式、MoE 与通信内核
repos.note_en: Persistent kernels and frameworks that fuse communication with tensor or expert computation.
repos.note_zh: 将通信与张量或专家计算融合的持久化内核和框架。

repos.title_zh: 支撑型运行时与基础组件
repos.note_en: Directly reused DSLs, tile primitives, synchronization, and communication substrates; not all are megakernels by themselves.
repos.note_zh: 被直接复用的 DSL、Tile 原语、同步和通信底座；它们本身不一定是 Megakernel。

readings.note_en: First-party implementation notes and reproducible walkthroughs.
readings.note_zh: 第一方实现说明与可复现实践文章。

readings.note_en: Engineering notes on tensor/expert parallelism, GPU-initiated communication, and overlap.
readings.note_zh: 张量/专家并行、GPU 发起通信与算通重叠的工程资料。

readings.note_en: Useful context whose claims should be read with the stated hardware and artifact limitations.
readings.note_zh: 提供背景与实践视角；阅读结论时需同时考虑其硬件和制品限制。

papers.name: AutoMegaKernel: A Statically-Checked Agent Harness for Self-Retargeting Megakernel Synthesis
papers.summary_en: Uses an agent-facing schedule IR plus static deadlock and race checks to synthesize one cooperative CUDA forward kernel across several NVIDIA architectures.
papers.summary_zh: 通过面向 Agent 的调度 IR 与死锁/竞态静态检查，在多代 NVIDIA 架构上合成单个 cooperative CUDA 前向内核。

papers.name: Ada-MK: Adaptive MegaKernel Optimization via Automated DAG-based Search for LLM Inference
papers.summary_en: Hoists scheduling decisions into an offline MLIR DAG search and integrates the resulting decode megakernel into a hybrid TensorRT-LLM serving path on NVIDIA L20.
papers.summary_zh: 将调度决策前移到离线 MLIR DAG 搜索，并把生成的 Decode Megakernel 集成到 NVIDIA L20 上的混合 TensorRT-LLM 服务路径。

papers.name: DITRON: Distributed Multi-level Tiling Compiler for Parallel Tensor Programs
papers.summary_en: Introduces Core-, Device-, and Task-level tiling; the Task level composes Triton tasks and communication into a distributed megakernel with scoreboard scheduling.
papers.summary_zh: 提出 Core、Device、Task 三级 Tiling；Task 层通过记分牌调度把 Triton 任务与通信组合为分布式 Megakernel。

papers.name: Fleet: Hierarchical Task-based Abstraction for Megakernels on Multi-Die GPUs
papers.summary_en: Adds chiplet-aware tasks and per-chiplet scheduling to a persistent runtime so MI350 workers can coordinate through the correct private L2 hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh: 在持久化运行时中加入 Chiplet 感知任务与逐 Chiplet 调度，使 MI350 Worker 能围绕正确的私有 L2 层级协作。

papers.name: Event Tensor: A Unified Abstraction for Compiling Dynamic Megakernel
papers.summary_en: Represents dependencies between tiled tasks as event tensors, enabling static and dynamic scheduling for shape- and data-dependent persistent kernels.
papers.summary_zh: 以 Event Tensor 表达 Tile 任务依赖，为形状和数据相关的持久化内核提供静态与动态调度。

papers.name: MPK: A Compiler and Runtime for Mega-Kernelizing Tensor Programs
papers.summary_en: Lowers tensor programs to SM-level task graphs and executes them with a decentralized in-kernel runtime, enabling cross-operator pipelines and fine-grained compute-communication overlap.
papers.summary_zh: 把张量程序降为 SM 级任务图，并由去中心化的 Kernel 内运行时执行，从而实现跨算子流水与细粒度算通重叠。

papers.name: FlashFormer: Whole-Model Kernels for Efficient Low-Batch Inference
papers.summary_en: A proof-of-concept whole-model kernel that fuses a complete Transformer forward pass for latency-sensitive low-batch inference.
papers.summary_zh: 面向低 Batch、低延迟推理的整模型 Kernel 原型，将完整 Transformer 前向融合在一个内核中。

papers.name: ExpertPlex: A High-Goodput Disaggregated Serving System for MoE LLMs with Adaptive Persistent Kernels
papers.summary_en: Shares expert weights across prefill and decode while adaptive tile-granular persistent kernels isolate and schedule dynamic expert computation.
papers.summary_zh: 在 Prefill 与 Decode 间共享专家权重，并用自适应 Tile 粒度持久化内核隔离、调度动态专家计算。

papers.name: Eliminating Hidden Serialization in Multi-Node Megakernel Communication
papers.summary_en: Complements FlashMoE by removing fence-induced serialization in its proxy RDMA transport while leaving the megakernel's core compute components unchanged.
papers.summary_zh: 在不改动 FlashMoE 核心计算组件的前提下，消除其 Proxy RDMA 传输中的 Fence 串行化，是对 Megakernel 通信层的补充。

papers.name: RaMP: Runtime-Aware Megakernel Polymorphism for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.summary_en: Selects among polymorphic CuTe kernel configurations from the runtime expert-routing histogram rather than batch size alone.
papers.summary_zh: 依据运行时专家路由直方图，而不是仅凭 Batch Size，在多种 CuTe 内核配置间动态选择。

papers.name: UniEP: Unified Expert-Parallel MoE MegaKernel for LLM Training
papers.summary_en: Fuses expert-parallel communication and computation into configurable megakernels while preserving deterministic token ordering; its implementation lives inside the broader Triton-distributed project.
papers.summary_zh: 把专家并行通信与计算融合为可配置 Megakernel，并保持确定性 Token 顺序；实现位于更大的 Triton-distributed 项目中。

papers.name: Alpha-MoE: A Megakernel for Faster Tensor Parallel Inference
papers.summary_en: A Hopper-oriented W8A8 MoE-layer megakernel that fuses the two projections, activation, quantization, and local combine for tensor-parallel serving.
papers.summary_zh: 面向 Hopper 的 W8A8 MoE 层 Megakernel，为张量并行服务融合两次投影、激活、量化与本地 Combine。

papers.name: ClusterFusion: Expanding Operator Fusion Scope for LLM Inference via Cluster-Level Collective Primitive
papers.summary_en: Uses Hopper thread-block clusters and distributed shared-memory collectives to keep intermediates on-chip across QKV projection, decode attention, and output projection; it is attention-stage fusion rather than a persistent whole-model runtime.
papers.summary_zh: 利用 Hopper Thread-block Cluster 与分布式共享内存 Collective，使 QKV 投影、Decode Attention 和输出投影的中间结果留在片上；属于 Attention 阶段融合，而非持久化整模型运行时。

papers.name: FlashMoE: Fast Distributed MoE in a Single Kernel
papers.summary_en: Fuses dispatch, expert computation, combine, and GPU-initiated inter-GPU communication into one persistent kernel.
papers.summary_zh: 把 Dispatch、专家计算、Combine 与 GPU 发起的跨 GPU 通信融合进单个持久化内核。

papers.name: Mirage: A Multi-Level Superoptimizer for Tensor Programs
papers.summary_en: Provides the multi-level μGraph representation and verified tensor-program search that later underpins the MPK compiler stack.
papers.summary_zh: 提供多层 μGraph 表示与带验证的张量程序搜索，后来成为 MPK 编译栈的基础。

papers.name: PipeThreader: Software-Defined Pipelining for Efficient DNN Execution
papers.summary_en: Introduces sTask graphs and software-defined pipelines over specialized GPU units; it is a compiler foundation rather than a whole-model megakernel.
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向 GPU 专用单元的 sTask 图与软件定义流水线；它是编译基础，而非整模型 Megakernel。

papers.name: ThunderKittens: Simple, Fast, and Adorable Kernels
papers.summary_en: Supplies the tile primitives and persistent-grid programming layer used by HazyResearch's single- and multi-GPU megakernels.
papers.summary_zh: 提供 HazyResearch 单 GPU 与多 GPU Megakernel 所使用的 Tile 原语和 Persistent-grid 编程层。

papers.name: A Framework for Fine-Grained Synchronization of Dependent GPU Kernels
papers.summary_en: cuSync synchronizes dependent kernels at tile granularity, exposing overlap that kernel-wide barriers normally hide.
papers.summary_zh: cuSync 以 Tile 粒度同步相互依赖的内核，暴露通常被 Kernel 级 Barrier 隐藏的重叠机会。

papers.name: ARK: GPU-driven Code Execution for Distributed Deep Learning
papers.summary_en: A historical GPU-driven execution system whose loop kernel runs distributed application compute and communication without CPU intervention.
papers.summary_zh: 历史性的 GPU 驱动执行系统，其 Loop Kernel 可在没有 CPU 干预的情况下运行分布式应用的计算与通信。

papers.name: Rammer: Enabling Holistic Deep Learning Compiler Optimizations with rTasks
papers.summary_en: Introduces hardware-neutral rTasks and static spatio-temporal co-scheduling across and within operators.
papers.summary_zh: 提出硬件中立的 rTask，以及跨算子和算子内的静态时空协同调度。

papers.name: Persistent RNNs: Stashing Recurrent Weights On-Chip
papers.summary_en: An early demonstration that a persistent GPU kernel can retain model weights on-chip and improve low-batch sequence execution.
papers.summary_zh: 早期证明持久化 GPU 内核可将模型权重留在片上，并改善低 Batch 序列执行。

papers.name: A Study of Persistent Threads Style GPU Programming for GPGPU Workloads
papers.summary_en: Establishes the persistent-threads programming style, its scheduling benefits, and the workloads where it can lose.
papers.summary_zh: 系统讨论 Persistent Threads 编程方式、调度收益，以及可能失效的工作负载。

papers.name: VDCores: Resource Decoupled Programming and Execution for Asynchronous GPU
papers.summary_en: Challenges monolithic orchestration for asynchronous GPU units and instead schedules dependency-connected micro-ops over resource-isolated virtual cores.
papers.summary_zh: 针对异步 GPU 单元质疑单体式编排，改以依赖连接的 Micro-op 在资源隔离的 Virtual Core 上调度。

papers.name: Megakernel vs Wavefront GPU Path Tracing
papers.summary_en: A modern graphics comparison that helps separate the megakernel execution strategy from LLM-specific workloads.
papers.summary_zh: 现代图形学场景中的对比研究，有助于把 Megakernel 执行策略与 LLM 特有负载区分开。

papers.name: Deep Kernel Fusion for Transformers
papers.summary_en: Deeply fuses the SwiGLU MLP subgraph and integrates it with SGLang, but does not fuse the whole Transformer model.
papers.summary_zh: 对 SwiGLU MLP 子图进行深度融合并集成 SGLang，但并未融合完整 Transformer 模型。

papers.name: FlashFuser: Expanding the Scale of Kernel Fusion for Compute-Intensive Operators via Inter-Core Connection
papers.summary_en: Extends fusion across thread-block clusters using Hopper distributed shared memory; the scope is large subgraphs rather than a whole-model runtime.
papers.summary_zh: 利用 Hopper 分布式共享内存把融合扩展到 Thread-block Cluster；范围是大型子图，而非整模型运行时。

papers.name: Megakernels Considered Harmful: Wavefront Path Tracing on GPUs
papers.summary_en: The classic warning that large kernels can lose to wavefront execution when divergence, register pressure, and instruction footprint dominate.
papers.summary_zh: 经典反例：当分支发散、寄存器压力和指令体积主导时，大内核可能不如 Wavefront 执行。

repos.status_zh: Apache-2.0 制品；单 CUDA 设备、Batch Size 1、仅 Greedy，Llama/RoPE 变体有限

repos.summary_zh: 可运行的教学型制品，其 Phase Interpreter 可在一次 Launch 内完成 Prompt 消费和完整 Greedy-generation 循环。

repos.status_zh: 开源；支持 NVIDIA 与 AMD 后端
repos.summary_en: The public code vehicle for PipeThreader and a reusable task/tile compiler substrate; not itself a whole-model megakernel.
repos.summary_zh: PipeThreader 的公开代码载体和可复用 Task/Tile 编译底座；本身不是整模型 Megakernel。

repos.name: FlashInfer
repos.target_en: Production LLM serving kernel library; MonoMoE path
repos.target_zh: 生产级 LLM Serving 内核库；含 MonoMoE 路径
repos.status_en: Apache-2.0; broad NVIDIA generation coverage
repos.status_zh: Apache-2.0；覆盖多代 NVIDIA GPU
repos.summary_en: Not a whole-model system, but MonoMoE fuses routing, up projection, activation, down projection, and reduction into one launch.
repos.summary_zh: 不是整模型系统，但 MonoMoE 可在一次 Launch 中融合路由、上投影、激活、下投影和归约。

repos.name: DeepEP
repos.target_zh: 专家并行通信底座
repos.status_en: Open source; CUDA/NVLink/RDMA focused
repos.status_zh: 开源；聚焦 CUDA/NVLink/RDMA
repos.summary_en: A widely used MoE communication substrate and comparison point; it is not itself a megakernel.
repos.summary_zh: 常用的 MoE 通信底座与对照系统；其本身并不是 Megakernel。

repos.name: FLUX
repos.target_zh: 细粒度计算-通信融合
repos.status_en: Open source; distributed CUDA kernels
repos.status_zh: 开源；分布式 CUDA 内核
repos.summary_en: A neighboring substrate for overlapping collectives with GEMM; include it as a building block, not as a whole-model persistent runtime.
repos.summary_zh: 用于 Collective 与 GEMM 重叠的相邻底座；作为基础组件收录，而非整模型持久化运行时。

repos.name: cuSync
repos.target_zh: Tile 级同步策略
repos.status_en: Archived, read-only public research artifact; CUDA
repos.status_zh: 已归档、只读的公开研究制品；CUDA
repos.summary_en: Compiler and runtime mechanisms for overlapping dependent kernels at tile granularity.
repos.summary_zh: 用于在 Tile 粒度重叠相互依赖内核的编译器与运行时机制。

repos.name: Syncopate
repos.target_zh: Triton 源到源算通重叠
repos.status_en: Open OSDI 2026 artifact; Triton/CUDA
repos.status_zh: 开放的 OSDI 2026 制品；Triton/CUDA
repos.summary_en: Automatically generates chunk-level overlap from Triton programs; relevant to megakernel scheduling, though not a whole-model persistent kernel.
repos.summary_zh: 从 Triton 程序自动生成 Chunk 级算通重叠；与 Megakernel 调度直接相关，但不是整模型持久化内核。

repos.name: VDCores
repos.target_zh: 资源解耦的异步 GPU 执行
repos.status_en: Public research source with no visible license; 132-SM Hopper (sm_90a), demonstrated on GH200/H100 NVL
repos.status_zh: 公开研究源码但未展示许可证；固定 132-SM Hopper（sm_90a），示例为 GH200/H100 NVL
repos.summary_en: A concrete alternative to monolithic megakernel orchestration based on dependency-connected micro-operations.
repos.summary_zh: 以依赖连接的 Micro-operation 替代单体式 Megakernel 编排的具体方案。

readings.name: Mixture-of-Kittens: our open-source MoE megakernel for NVL72s
readings.summary_en: Explains reusable pull-dispatch/push-combine scheduling, minibatch overlap, the reversed macrobatch ring, exact SM partitioning, CLC coexistence with inter-rack communication, determinism, and author-reported NVL72 results.
readings.summary_zh: 解释可复用的 Pull-Dispatch/Push-Combine 调度、Minibatch 算通重叠、反向 Macrobatch Ring、精确 SM 分区、CLC 与跨机架通信共存、确定性及作者报告的 NVL72 结果。

readings.name: MegaKernel是创新还是传销？
readings.summary_en: A B300 case study of MegaRTP that separates gains from kernel fusion, multistream DAG execution, and PDL from the incremental value of tile-level megakernel scheduling.
readings.summary_zh: 在 B300 上分析 MegaRTP，并将 Kernel Fusion、Multistream DAG 与 PDL 的收益同 Megakernel Tile 级调度的增量价值分开归因。

readings.name: 如何看待 Hazy Research 团队将 1B 模型的 Forward 融合为一个 MegaKernel？
readings.summary_en: A Chinese walkthrough of the motivation, execution model, implementation, significance, and limitations of Hazy Research's Llama-1B megakernel.
readings.summary_zh: 从动机、执行模型、实现、意义与局限几个层面解读 Hazy Research 的 Llama-1B Megakernel。

readings.name: megakernel 的 sync 开销
readings.summary_en: Contrasts HBM-, LLC-, and L2-level synchronization in AMD-oriented megakernel designs and cautions that synchronization metadata traffic alone may not explain critical-path cost.
readings.summary_zh: 对比 AMD Megakernel 设计中的 HBM、LLC 与 L2 同步层级，并提醒同步元数据流量本身未必能解释关键路径成本。

readings.name: Megakernel
readings.summary_en: Uses MegaQwen's side-by-side per-operator and transformer-block megakernel directories to explain the two execution models.
readings.summary_zh: 利用 MegaQwen 并存的逐算子目录与 Transformer-block Megakernel 目录解释两种执行模型。

readings.name: MegaMoE 不止 MegaKernel
readings.summary_en: Places MegaMoE in the longer lineage of fused computation-collective operators and separates generic compute-communication overlap from megakernel-specific scheduling.
readings.summary_zh: 将 MegaMoE 放回融合计算与 Collective 的技术谱系，并区分通用算通重叠与 Megakernel 专属调度。

readings.name: Compiling Models to Megakernels
readings.summary_en: Luminal explains its global instruction queue, fine-grained barrier derivation, symbolic work queues, and one-kernel-per-model compiler path.
readings.summary_zh: Luminal 讲解全局指令队列、细粒度 Barrier 推导、符号化工作队列与一模型一内核的编译流程。

readings.name: We Bought the Whole GPU, So We're Damn Well Going to Use the Whole GPU
readings.summary_en: The multi-GPU tensor-parallel continuation of Hazy's Llama megakernel work, including its environment sensitivity and scheduling choices.
readings.summary_zh: Hazy Llama Megakernel 的多 GPU 张量并行续作，包含环境敏感性与调度选择。

readings.name: Look Ma, No Bubbles! Designing a Low-Latency Megakernel for Llama-1B
readings.summary_en: The clearest first-principles introduction to launch gaps, wave quantization, persistent scheduling, and Hazy's original implementation.
readings.summary_zh: 从第一性原理解释 Launch Gap、Wave Quantization、持久化调度与 Hazy 原始实现。

readings.name: Compiling LLMs into a Megakernel: A Path to Low-Latency Inference
readings.summary_en: An author-level overview of MPK's SM task graph, compiler, and in-kernel runtime.
readings.summary_zh: 由作者介绍 MPK 的 SM 任务图、编译器与 Kernel 内运行时。

readings.name: Megakernel: Matching Apple Silicon Efficiency at 2x the Throughput on a RTX 3090
readings.summary_en: Walks through Luce's persistent dispatch design and the constraints of model-specific serving kernels.
readings.summary_zh: 介绍 Luce 的持久化 Dispatch 设计，以及模型专用服务内核的约束。

readings.name: RTX 5090 Decode Optimization
readings.summary_en: The transparent engineering record behind qwen_megakernel, useful for understanding consumer-Blackwell constraints.
readings.summary_zh: qwen_megakernel 背后的透明工程记录，适合理解消费级 Blackwell 的约束。

readings.name: MegaQwen Development Log
readings.summary_en: A step-by-step record of correctness, memory movement, and kernel optimization decisions for a consumer GPU.
readings.summary_zh: 逐步记录消费级 GPU 上的正确性、数据搬运和内核优化决策。

readings.name: mKernel: Fast Multi-GPU, Multi-Node Fused Kernels
readings.summary_en: Explains GPU-initiated RDMA, SM specialization, and the library's fused collective-compute kernels.
readings.summary_zh: 解释 GPU 发起 RDMA、SM 专职化与库中的通信-计算融合内核。

readings.name: One Kernel for All Your GPUs
readings.summary_en: Introduces ThunderKittens PGL and communication directly from persistent multi-GPU kernels.
readings.summary_zh: 介绍 ThunderKittens PGL，以及在持久化多 GPU 内核中直接发起通信。

readings.name: Alpha-MoE: A Megakernel for Faster Tensor Parallel Inference
readings.summary_en: Explains Alpha-MoE's fusion boundary and serving integration; treat benchmark figures as author-reported and configuration-specific.
readings.summary_zh: 解释 Alpha-MoE 的融合边界与服务集成；性能数字应视为作者报告且依赖具体配置。

readings.name: Building a Single-Kernel LLM Engine on AMD MI300X
readings.summary_en: A technically detailed full-decode monokernel story covering prefill, sampling, and tensor parallelism; the implementation is closed and results are vendor-reported.
readings.summary_zh: 技术细节丰富的完整 Decode Monokernel 案例，覆盖 Prefill、Sampling 与张量并行；实现未开源，结果为厂商自报。

readings.name: PipeThreader: Software-Defined Pipelining for Efficient DNN Execution
readings.summary_en: A readable overview of sTask graphs, specialized GPU units, and software-defined pipelines.
readings.summary_zh: 易读地介绍 sTask 图、GPU 专用单元和软件定义流水线。

readings.name: How Rammer Squeezes More out of Accelerator Performance
readings.summary_en: Historical context for rTasks and holistic inter-/intra-operator scheduling.
readings.summary_zh: 理解 rTask 与跨算子/算子内整体调度的历史背景。
